item.title: Blit 0.2.45
item.description: Fourteen additions. Compare Panes (View menu, ⌃⌘C) marks what's only here, the same, or verified in the other pane's folder. A Video column (View › Columns) shows resolution, HDR or Dolby Vision, codec, audio and running time. Dragging onto a drive or NAS shows the free space the drop would leave. Space on a folder shows a summary: its size, the main video, the largest files and the .nfo. Suggested destinations: Move To and ⇧F6 offer the folder where the same show or kind of movie went last. Watch mode fetches new finished downloads from a server folder to this Mac (right-click a folder › Watch for New Downloads). Also: Rename With Preset in the right-click menu, spring-loaded folders, a dot on what's new since your last visit, monthly totals in the Transfer Log and the menu bar, a pixel flourish when a big queue finishes verified, importing servers from Transmit and ForkLift, a Welcome for new installs, and measuring the best number of connections for a server (server editor › Measure…).
